description: Copilot evaluation cases. expect_tools: at least one of these must be called. expect_numbers: the answer must contain each value (matched with the verifier's rounding rules). Expected numbers are produced by the deterministic engines, not written by hand. expect_from may be a list: the answer is accurate if it matches any one of them (e.g. lender-exact vs generic method).
